fields.description: Sei Saadiyat brings apartments and Kanso lofts to Saadiyat Cultural District. The six-building development combines 778 homes with shared gardens and wellbeing spaces. Its first launch covered 265 homes, so building and release details matter when comparing a particular apartment.

overview: Natural materials and light are central to the interiors. The brochure describes stone, timber, metal and woven finishes, with selected detailing sourced from Japan. Kanso Lofts introduce a split-level arrangement with a living volume open to the floor above, giving these homes a different spatial character from the conventional apartments.
research.locationNote: Sei Saadiyat is within Saadiyat Cultural District. The brochure situates it near Abrahamic Family House and the district museums; outlook and walking routes depend on the selected building and floor.
research.priceNote: Aldar advertises homes from AED 2.95m and a 2% ADM fee waiver. These do not establish available stock, eligibility for incentives or the full acquisition cost. Confirm a dated unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: Aldar confirms 50/50 with 5% down. Masterpiece Property supplies the dated launch schedule shown below; the signed agreement controls exact dates and remaining balances.
research.handoverNote: Aldar states handovers commence from Q4 2030. This is an estimated programme, not a guarantee for every building or apartment.

facts.value: 778 homes across six buildings overall. The September 2026 announcement identifies 265 homes in the first two-building release; neither total means unsold inventory.

facts.label: Design team
facts.value: Aldar names Jacobs for architecture and Kettle Collective for interiors.

facts.label: Sustainability target
facts.value: The launch announcement targets Estidama Pearl 3 and includes EV provisions. A target is not an achieved certification.

facts.label: Layout distinction
facts.value: The reviewed three-bedroom Kanso plan has a maid room; the loft drawing distributes bedrooms across two levels around an open living volume. Check the exact type and accessibility of its internal stairs.
